channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: 4 held over attempted cable theft at electrical substation in Segambut
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Police arrested four men over attempted cable theft at a Tenaga Nasional Bhd (TNB) electrical substation in Jalan Segambut Pusat here on Wednesday.

item.title: [UPDATED] First female Chief Judge of Malaya Siti Norma Yaakob dies at 85
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Tan Sri Siti Norma Yaakob, the first woman to be appointed Chief Judge of Malaya, died today.

item.title: Perak new NCID chief and district police chiefs
item.description: IPOH: Perak police have received several new senior appointments, including the head of the Narcotics Criminal Investigation Department (NCID) and police chiefs for the Hilir Perak and Ipoh districts.

item.title: Kolej Poly-Tech Mara spreads Ramadan cheer to orphans, B40 children
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Kolej Poly-Tech MARA Sdn Bhd (KPTMSB) organised an Ihya’ Ramadan programme as part of its corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiative to celebrate Ramadan with 50 orphans, asnaf and B40 children from Madrasah Baitur Rahmah.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: George Lam, Sally Yeh spotted enjoying ice cream in KL ahead of concert
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Hong Kong celebrity couple George Lam and Sally Yeh are already in Kuala Lumpur ahead of their upcoming We Are One concert at Bukit Jalil’s Axiata Arena on March 14.

item.title: Dusk brings rush for Kak Yam's famous penjaram at Ramadan buffet
item.description: KOTA KINABALU: As dusk falls in Kota Belud, the scent of sizzling penjaram fills the air as Mariam Magit fries thousands for eager Ramadan buffet diners.

item.title: Tightening financing, loan rejections derail home purchases in Malaysia
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Loan rejections remain a major hurdle for prospective homebuyers in Malaysia, with developers cautioning that tightening financing conditions are increasingly derailing property purchases.

item.title: 4 naturalised players become local players
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) left no room for argument when it comes to the four naturalised footballers.

item.title: Court of Appeal allows Chegubard to obtain Bloomberg journalist's statement
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: The Court of Appeal today allowed an appeal by Badrul Hisham Shaharin, also known as Chegubard, to reinstate the Sessions Court order directing the prosecution to disclose a witness statement to him for use in his defence in a sedition case.

item.title: MACC freezes RM4 million in Selangor land misappropriation probe
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) has frozen bank accounts belonging to four individuals and four companies, totalling RM4 million, in an investigation into land misappropriation in Selangor.
